description: Эльфийская хранительница знаний из Ривенделла. Мастер посоха, света и защиты отряда.

skills.name: Sanctuary
skills.description: How to use: Press RT+B (on Xbox 360) to conjure a protective orb that defends from ranged attacks. Info: Can be enhanced with the Healing Light, Sanctuary Mastery, Wrath of the Eldar and Forceful Fire skills.

skills.name: Healing Light
skills.description: Info: Unlocks and increases healing done by Sanctuary. Sanctuary must be active for effects. Higher ranks increases healing rate.

skills.name: Preservation
skills.description: Skills used by any party members cost less power.

skills.name: Focus Mind
skills.description: Upgrade the elf's passive power regeneration.

skills.name: Shielding Light
skills.description: How to use: Press LB+B (on Xbox 360) for a temporary Armor bonus. Info: Additional ranks add to the Armor bonus and increase duration.

skills.name: Sanctuary Mastery
skills.description: Increases the duration of sanctuary.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: How to use: Press LB+A (on Xbox 360) to instantly heal nearby party members. Info: Higher ranks add to the amount of Health restored.

skills.name: Word of Command
skills.description: How to use: Press RT+X (on Xbox 360) to unleash a magical shockwave in all directions. Info: Can be upgraded with the Loremaster’s Reach and Sundering Command skills.

skills.name: Clarity
skills.description: Chance each time a skill is cast the next is free and does not trigger a cooldown.

skills.name: Loremaster's Reach
skills.description: Upgrades the range of your word of command and tempest skills.

skills.name: Tempest
skills.description: How to use: Press LB+Y (on Xbox 360) to blast targets with a force of elemental energy. Info: Additional ranks increase the damage applied, expand the effective range and knock enemies back.

skills.name: Smite
skills.description: How to use: Press RT+Y (on Xbox 360) to devastate a single target Info: Higher ranks add chain damage to additional targets and increase the damage inflicted.

skills.name: Quick-Minded
skills.description: Reduces the cooldowns of your active skills.

skills.name: Strength of Will
skills.description: Grants a bonus to armor based on your current will.

skills.name: Renewed Power
skills.description: Each killing blow achieved with a skill regenerates power.

skills.name: Sundering Command
skills.description: How to use: Hold RT+X (on Xbox 360) to follow Word of Command with an overwhelming area attack. Info: Higher ranks increase damage inflicted.

skills.name: Staff and Steel
skills.description: Info: Unlocks dual wielding of a 1-Handed Weapon alongside the staff and increases your damage. Additional ranks increase damage while dual wielding.

skills.name: Empower Staff
skills.description: How to use: Hold LT+RB(on Xbox 360) to power-up your ranged attacks, firing multiple charges at once. Info: Can be enhanced with the Magnify Staff skill.

skills.name: Staff Mastery
skills.description: increases damage done with staves.

skills.name: Magnify Staff
skills.description: Increases the rate that staff ranged attacks charge, and increases the damage bonus of charge shots.

skills.name: Elemental Affinity
skills.description: Increase the duration of fire, ice, and lightning effects you inflict on enemies.

skills.name: Wrath of the Eldar
skills.description: How to use: Press RT+B(on Xbox 360) to dispel Sanctuary with a powerful detonation. Requires Sanctuary. Info: Higher ranks increase detonation damage.

skills.name: Forceful Fire
skills.description: Info: Any ranged attacks fired through or within Sanctuary do extra damage. Higher ranks increase damage.

skills.name: Burst of Light
skills.description: How to use: Press LT+X (on Xbox 360) to conjure a slow but highly lethal bolt of explosive energy. Press LT+X (on Xbox 360) again to detonate it. Info: Additional ranks increase damage. • enemies with shield may block it (they'll recieve no damage, but surrounding enemies do).
